name: context-bar
title: Context bar
description: One dark band of key facts about the record being viewed (promotion, market, period, owner), in the menu bar colours, with an optional gold action chip.
whenToUse: Top of detail pages (result, workflow, logistics) to keep the record in view. One per page, under the page header.

variants.description: Gold action chip on the right.

a11y: Facts are a <dl>: each fact is a <div> with <dt> label and <dd> value.
